title: oracle-sid-brute
author: Patrik Karlsson
description: Guesses Oracle instance/SID names against the TNS-listener. If the oraclesids script argument is not used to specify an alternate file, the default oracle-sids file will be used. License to use the oracle-sids file was granted by its author, Alexander Kornbrust (http://seclists.org/nmap-dev/2009/q4/645).
